knowledgeAnswers.rationale: It is the income the business must reach to replace your lifestyle costs; the other answers measure different things.
Tax and insurance are real costs that the business income must cover, so they belong in the freedom number.
Costs and goals change, so the number should be reviewed regularly.
The freedom number section says to work out the lifestyle cost from rent or mortgage, bills, insurance, vehicle, tax, savings and personal spending.
